Maria: final sprint deploy in 30m — target cutover 15:00 UTC. Quick checklist below, pls ack your line:
- Maria: coordinate cutover and smoke
- Kevin: smoke ownership + post-cutover perf check
- Devon: rollback readiness + traffic-shift
- Priya: release notes + external comms

Kevin: Ack. I'll run smoke tests and watch latencies in dashboard. Keeping curl check script ready. :thumbsup:

Devon: On call for rollback. I have the fallback image tagged r-2026-02-12-rc. If we need to flip, I'll shift traffic back to stable within 3m.

Maria: One question — any DB migrations? @Kevin

Kevin: No schema changes. Just config flag flips (feature gates). We'll gate with ff:final_sprint (false -> true) after smoke.

Priya: I'll push the release notes to the docs site and ping partners after cutover. Draft is at /docs/releases/final-sprint.md

ops-bot: deploy job scheduled by @maria at 2026-03-18T14:30:00Z — job id 67921 — CI passed ✅

Kevin: Smoke run steps (short):
1) curl https://api.redwood.test/health
2) run load-smoke --concurrency 10 --dur 60
3) check tokens/time breakdown in console

Devon: Rollback plan condensed:
- set feature flag ff:final_sprint -> false
- point ROUTER weight stable=100
- redeploy stable image if needed: kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-runtime

Maria: TL;DR: folks ack here and note any blockers within 10m. If you can't, ping me directly.

Kevin: ACK
Devon: ACK
Priya: ACK

Maria: Ready. I'll flip the canary to 5% at T+2m, smoke, then ramp if no red flags. :rocket:

Kevin: I'll post smoke results in this thread.

Priya: I'll send partner note once 50% ramp completes.

Devon: I'll be in #eng-oncall for the next hour. Ping me if latency > 400ms or errors > 0.5%.
